violations.message: lanes culture_neurons, culture_microglia, culture_astrocytes share 'split_1' and 'junction_mid': filling one lane through its own inlet with outlet_1 vented also pushes up to 21% of the flow through the other lanes. To fill one lane alone, feed the lane's inlet and vent its own <lane>_vent_out port with outlet_1 capped: then no liquid enters the other lanes.

lanes pcr_1, pcr_2, pcr_3, pcr_4 share 'split_2' and 'pool_2': filling one lane through its own inlet with outlet_1 vented also pushes up to 38% of the flow through the other lanes. To fill one lane alone, feed the lane's inlet and vent its own <lane>_vent_out port with outlet_1 capped: then no liquid enters the other lanes.
